companyIntro.name: Arcline Architects
companyIntro.mission: Design buildings people love to use and that regulators can approve first time.
companyIntro.culture: Concept with discipline: every beautiful idea must survive area schedules, codes and costs.

projectBackground.name: Residential Tower — Block B
projectBackground.context: The client wants more sellable area without breaking the plot ratio or fire egress rules.

manager.name: Giulia Ferri
manager.note: A good design is generous and legal. Show me the efficiency, the ratio and that people can get out.

assignment.title: Optimise the tower layout
assignment.brief: Compute efficiency, plot ratio and stair risers, total the unit mix in Excel and write the design statement.

documents.name: Area Schedule
documents.note: GFA 5,000 m²; net internal area 3,750 m²; plot 2,000 m².

documents.name: Unit Mix
documents.note: Studios, 1-bed and 2-bed units with counts and sizes.

tasks.title: Efficiency
tasks.prompt: NIA 3,750 m² and GFA 5,000 m². What is the efficiency (%)?
tasks.reasoning: Efficiency shows how much area is sellable.
tasks.mistake: Dividing by NIA inverts the measure.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Plot Ratio
tasks.prompt: GFA 5,000 m² on a plot of 2,000 m². What is the plot ratio?
tasks.reasoning: Plot ratio is capped by planning.
tasks.tip: Check measurement rules with the authority.
tasks.mistake: Excluding areas that count adds risk.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Stair Risers
tasks.prompt: Floor-to-floor 3.3 m with riser 165 mm. How many risers per storey?
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Egress
tasks.prompt: Why do tall residential buildings need more than one escape route?
options: So occupants can escape if one route is blocked by fire or smoke
tasks.mistake: One escape route is a single point of failure.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Unit Mix (Excel)
tasks.prompt: Total area in column D = B x C for each type.
tasks.reasoning: Total of 3,550 m² against the 3,750 m² NIA leaves 200 m² to check.
tasks.mistake: Unreconciled schedules cause errors at sale.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Design Statement
tasks.prompt: Write a 3-5 sentence design statement for planning.
tasks.modelAnswer: Block B delivers 65 homes in a tower with 75% efficiency and a plot ratio of 2.5, within policy. A generous entrance and shared garden create a clear arrival and amenity for residents. Two protected stairs and a firefighting lift provide safe egress. Materials respond to the neighbourhood with a brick base and lighter upper floors.
tasks.reasoning: A good statement ties design intent to metrics and compliance.
tasks.mistake: Pretty words without metrics don't win approval.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

caseStudy.title: Case Study: The Plan That Failed Fire Review
caseStudy.background: A tower design was approved by the client but failed fire review because only one stair was provided. Redesign cost 8% of floor area.
caseStudy.constraints: Design focused on views and efficiency.
questions: How would you bring it forward?
caseStudy.solution: Arcline involves the fire engineer at concept stage.
caseStudy.lessonsLearned: Design with safety from day one.

How would you reconcile area schedules?
